SELECT
    toYear(DateKey) AS CalendarYear,
    sum(SalesAmount) AS TotalSalesAmount,
    sum(SalesAmount) - lagInFrame(sum(SalesAmount)) OVER (ORDER BY toYear(DateKey)) AS YoY_Change,
    round(
        (sum(SalesAmount) - lagInFrame(sum(SalesAmount)) OVER (ORDER BY toYear(DateKey)))
        * 100.0
        / nullif(lagInFrame(sum(SalesAmount)) OVER (ORDER BY toYear(DateKey)), 0),
        2
    ) AS YoY_Growth_Pct
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
GROUP BY CalendarYear
ORDER BY CalendarYear
